channel.title: Homes Under the Hammer
channel.desc: A pair of semi-detached cottages in Dormansland in Surrey, a semi-detached house in Chippenham in Wiltshire and a two-bedroom ground-floor flat in Surbiton in Greater London are sold at online property auctions. Martin and Tommy meet the new owners, hear their plans before the final finished properties are revealed.
